caseName: Eugene Holden v. Roger Arnebergh, City Attorney, Los Angeles
caseNameFull: HOLDEN Et Al. v. ARNEBERGH, CITY ATTORNEY OF LOS ANGELES, Et Al.
attorneys: Burton Marks for appellants., Roger Arnebergh, pro se, and Robert B. Burns for appellees.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is dismissed, it appearing that the judgment below rests upon an adequate state ground.
